label: Late-episode D2 after a2 is repeated following an unrewarded rare a2 trial
explanation: Fires only at D2, only when this trial chose a2 (input action = a2), and only in trials 80-99 of the episode, with rate doubling in trials 90-99. The previous trial was almost always unrewarded (98% of mass) and a rare transition (82% of mass; the rest is the window first trial, where prev_common is unknown), so in practice it is a2 -> S1 rare, unrewarded, then the agent stays with a2, which is the model-based stay response. The state reached does not matter (S1 55%, S2 45% of mass). The policy logit at D2 sits in a moderately a2-leaning band (-8.9 to -4.4), and value is low (85% of mass is in the bottom value bin). It never fires at D1 or GO, after a1 choices, before trial 80, or after rewarded trials. Without model variables, the predicate D2 & a2 & prev unrewarded & prev not common & ep_trial>=80 gives dev F1 0.41 with mass recall 0.98. Adding the choice-logit band raises dev F1 to 0.53 (precision 0.36, recall 0.95). Precision stays low: it fires on only about a third of matching steps, and no observed variable we checked separates those. The late-episode restriction suggests it partly tracks elapsed time in the episode.
